title: phase-result
description: Structured outcome of a full-implementation-cycle phase (harness-pt08). run-phase.sh passes it with --json-schema and validates it again on the block extracted from the result event; cycle-state.sh applies its rules. Only the keywords type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minLength, minimum: the minimal validator of run-phase.sh rejects the others. No slashes in the text: the schema is passed as an argument to claude.exe and MSYS would convert them as paths.

fase.description: The phase being closed: it must match the one in the run-phase.sh label.

esito.description: OK or STOP. With a non-empty deviazioni or a bloccato_su other than nessuno the phase is STOP anyway.

motivo.description: The summary of the ESITO FASE line.

deviazioni.description: Every plan step not carried out as written (adapted or minor ones too). Empty if none. A purely defensive one starts with "difensiva: ": if all of them do, the phase does not stop for a deviation.

bloccato_su.description: The literal nessuno, or the reason for the block (e.g. migrazione da applicare).

file.description: Files touched by the phase, relative to the repository.

gate_interni.description: Gates run inside the phase (inner loop of the implementer, counterproofs of the review).

finding.description: Review findings (or those of the fix that closes them).

copertura.description: Optional, review phase (harness-pt09): for each requirement the IDs of the tests that cover it (pytest node id, vitest full name or test file, id of a counterproof), NEVER the results. finalize.sh joins them to the results of VERIFY and builds the Evidence table; an ID with no result leaves the requirement not covered.
